name: Practical Prey
summary: Vel'rin Fang calls for tiger hides from the Echo Isles to supply Sen'jin Village. The Darkspear's numbers grow, and their stores run low.

sections.title: A Matter of Survival
sections.body: Along Durotar's harsh coast, the Darkspear of Sen'jin Village make every resource last. Tiger pelts become tents, blankets and armor. Refugees arrive and scouts return, thinning the village stores. So leatherworker Vel'rin Fang sends hunters to bring back more hides.

sections.title: Balance and the Hunt
sections.body: The Darkspear hunt Durotar's tigers only when the tribe needs more supplies. Their hunters cross the water to the Echo Isles and track the predators there. For the trolls, each hunt also tests patience, discipline and skill in the wild.

faq.answer: Vel'rin Fang is a Darkspear leatherworker in Sen'jin Village. He sends hunters for the hides the tribe needs to make clothing, shelter and gear.

faq.q: Why does Sen'jin Village need tiger furs?
faq.answer: Sen'jin Village uses tiger pelts for tents, blankets and armor. As the population grows, the village stores have come under strain.

faq.q: Where are the Durotar tigers found?
faq.answer: Durotar's tigers roam the Echo Isles, just off the region's southeastern coast.

faq.q: Why don't the trolls hunt all the tigers nearby?
faq.answer: The Darkspear leave the tigers alone until they need more supplies. They take only what the tribe needs, allowing the predators to thrive.

faq.q: Is hunting tigers significant to Darkspear culture?
faq.answer: Yes. The Darkspear see tiger hunting as a test of patience and cunning. Vel'rin once waited nearly a day in the Echo Isles before claiming his first great hunting victory.

faq.q: Why must hunters travel to the Echo Isles if Zalazane holds them?
faq.answer: Zalazane and his hexed minions hold much of the Echo Isles, but wild beasts remain plentiful. Hunting and scavenging along the outer shores still bring risks the Darkspear must take.

angles.text: As a Darkspear troll, you hunt across the Echo Isles and provide for your clan. The islands remind you bitterly of the home Zalazane took from your people.
As a hunter, you know patience and precision matter. Vel'rin once tracked his prey in silence for a full day before springing his trap.
As a member of the Horde, you help supply the young Darkspear enclave and anchor the Horde's southern flank along the Great Sea.
